quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on team's performance and need for consistency
quotes.excerpt: we just got to find a way to channel that even more.
quotes.quote: I am proud of how we started, outside of that stretch at the end of the first and the majority of the second. We played really good basketball. Those guys had a lot of pop to them. We just got to find a way to channel that even more. Obviously, they went on a little run there to build their lead, but then we kept fighting and only lost the quarter by four. Outside of that stretch there, I thought our guys played really good basketball today. So give Tatum and George credit, they are heck of a players. We just got to find a way to continue to stay the course, get three stops in a row, things that we have been talking about.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins on the team performance after the loss to the Celtics. He says the team played good basketball outside of a few stretches but needs to find a way to stay the course and get three stops in a row.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins discusses the team's performance against their opponents and credits Jayson Tatum and Paul George for their play.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on Brook Lopez's struggles and role
quotes.excerpt: we definitely got to find a way to get him going on the offensive side.
quotes.quote: He is impacting the games in a lot of other ways. Multiple rebounds, assists, blocked shots, defensive anchor for us. We definitely got to find a way to get him going on the offensive side. I think his teammates are trusting him, he is shooting open looks. I know he has forced a couple when he has gotten to the role, but we need to roll at times, and I am glad he has added that to his pocket. He is just going through a rough patch right now. He just has to stay the course, keep trusting the work. He is the first person to say, if I am not grooving on the offensive side, I have to find other ways to impact it.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins addresses Brook Lopez's offensive struggles. He says Lopez is going through a rough patch but is still impacting the game as a defensive anchor and must keep trusting the work.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins addresses Brook Lopez's current offensive struggles while praising his defensive contributions and overall impact.

quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins provides injury update on Tyler

quotes.quote: He is feeling fine right now. We will continue to evaluate. Obviously, he went back in the game and played. I could see maybe he had a little soreness. I think just someone landed on his knee. It does not sound like it is anything more than that. Obviously, they cleared him to come back in the game, so maybe contusion. quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins provides an update on Tyler after he took a hit to the knee. He says it does not sound like anything more than a contusion and he was cleared to return to the game.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on recent decline in bench minutes
quotes.excerpt: the impact that they can make, I need more consistency out of that.
quotes.quote: It is a combination of things. I know what those guys are fully capable of, the impact that they can make, I need more consistency out of that. Then I see it out of other guys too. When they are making their mark, then I trust my gut in sub patterns there. I felt like there was a couple of other guys in the last couple of games that were playing a little bit better. Getting Ryan going as well, I think Nate is playing well, Jay-Rock has been staying ready, his level of physicality, maybe some schematic things too. Those guys, obviously, I know that they can play better, and I want them to engage in that process of just finding ways to constantly impact the game both sides of the floor.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins explains the recent decline in bench minutes. He says he needs more consistency from that group and is currently trusting his gut based on which players are making their mark on the floor.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins explains the recent reduction in bench minutes and his expectations for consistency from his reserve players.

quotes.speaker: Taylor Jenkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Taylor Jenkins on team focus ahead of upcoming schedule
quotes.excerpt: we are not even talking about the future with these guys. We talked about the game today.
quotes.quote: I am not even talking about the future with these guys. We talked about the game today, outside of that pocket in the first and then the second quarter, I thought we played some pretty good basketball there. We had some life to us, started the game, tried to respond there in the second half. I felt like we actually found a little bit of rhythm on the offensive side when we were not really finding it there in the second quarter and then our end of quarter management at the end of the first kind of really bit us. So, not really thinking about the next two games, we just got to focus on tomorrow. Obviously, travel involved as you said and get ready for some tough challenges, but continue to stay the course, trusting things we are talking about, everyone looking in the mirror and figuring out how they can continue to get better, impact winning, but at the end of the day, we got to do it together.
quotes.social_post: Taylor Jenkins on the team mindset moving forward. He says they are not looking ahead to the schedule and are focused on tomorrow and figuring out how everyone can continue to get better and impact winning together.

structured.context: Taylor Jenkins discusses the team's need to focus on immediate improvements rather than looking ahead at the upcoming schedule.
